title: Find why the user cache serves stale data
description: A small user-lookup service caches results in a TTL cache. Users report stale data after renames, duplicate backend calls, and wrong hit/miss statistics, and several tests in `test_service.py` fail. The cause is spread over three modules (`keys.py`, `store.py`, `service.py`). Trace how a key flows from the service through `make_key` into the cache, find every root cause and fix it in the right module. Read the docstrings: they define the intended behaviour. Do not change the tests or public signatures.
